title: Badge
description: A small count or status indicator attached to the corner of another element.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Wrap an element and set content. Give the badge an ariaLabel that describes what the number means.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Nine color schemes; error is an alias of danger.

positions.title: Positions
positions.description: Attach the badge to any corner with position.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: small, medium (default) and large.

dot.title: Dot
dot.description: dot replaces the content with a small dot, for "something new" indicators.

with-icon.title: With icon
with-icon.description: icon is displayed before the content.

custom-style.title: Custom styles
custom-style.description: Override colors, border and radius with bgColor, textColor, borderWidth, borderColor and borderRadius.

BadgeProps.children: Element the badge is attached to
BadgeProps.className: Additional class name of the badge
BadgeProps.content: Content displayed inside the badge (count, short text...)
BadgeProps.position: Corner of the children the badge is placed on
BadgeProps.dot: Renders a small dot instead of content
BadgeProps.ariaLabel: Accessible label of the badge, e.g. "5 unread messages"
